tasks.short: Handle employee complaints, investigate concerns, agree action and follow up.

steps.what: Receive the concern and assess immediate safety, confidentiality and escalation needs.
Hear the employee's account and explain confidentiality limits and next steps.
Read authorised records and organise accounts, dates and conflicting evidence.

loop.input: Authorised case evidence and accounts selected by the HR specialist.
loop.output: A source-linked timeline separating reported allegations, documented events and unresolved contradictions.
loop.check: Check source passages, dates and attribution; the HR specialist verifies completeness and disputed statements.
loop.stop: One extraction pass and one repair pass per document; unreadable or conflicting material returns to manual review.
loop.why_not_simpler: Accounts and evidence use free text; fixed fields cannot reliably extract events and attribution.

steps.what: Assess credibility, policy implications and options using the verified evidence.
Review findings and authorise action within the relevant management mandate.
Prepare outcome letters and follow-up instructions for each authorised recipient.

loop.input: Approved case action, verified findings, approved template and recipient disclosure limits.
loop.output: Separate draft outcome letters containing only authorised findings and actions.
loop.check: Compare each statement with approved findings; check recipient access and require HR specialist approval before release.
loop.stop: One draft and one revision per recipient; unsupported wording or disclosure uncertainty returns to manual drafting.
loop.why_not_simpler: Templates handle fixed sections, but case-specific explanations require careful free-text drafting.

steps.what: Explain the outcome privately and agree support and follow-up.
File the case record and schedule restricted follow-up reminders.

tasks.design: Configure restricted case folders in the {DOCS} and follow-up forms and reminders in the {WORKFLOW}. Small bounded loops prepare source-linked timelines and draft letters from selected evidence and approved actions; the HR specialist checks them before use or release. Interviews, credibility assessments and consequential decisions remain human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Sensitive evidence sits in separate documents and messages. Credibility and disclosure decisions cannot be reduced to routing rules.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing access controls and workflow settings cover case administration. AI-assisted coding makes source linking and template assembly cheaper; bounded extraction still needs close review.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting accounts, retaliation concerns and safe disclosure remain difficult. GDPR applies; employment procedures and employee consultation depend on national rules. No emotion inference or automated credibility scoring is proposed.
tasks.human_edge: Create trust, notice vulnerability, weigh conflicting accounts and explain difficult outcomes with care.

tasks.short: Analyse employment data and prepare required workforce reports.

Reconcile identifiers, dates and organisational categories in the reporting workbook.
Calculate required totals, rates and comparisons using agreed definitions.
Interpret changes and assemble the report with explanatory notes.
Check explanations, disclosure scope and required report content.
Distribute the corrected report to authorised internal recipients.
Submit required external returns and retain the submission receipt.

tasks.short: Conduct exit interviews, complete termination paperwork, and coordinate approved departure records.

Arrange an exit interview with the departing employee.
Discuss departure reasons, listen to concerns, and take factual notes.
Write a restricted interview summary and separate concerns needing confidential follow-up.

loop.output: A source-linked summary with proposed follow-up flags.
loop.check: The HR specialist checks attribution, omissions, sensitive details, and referral recipients before saving.
loop.stop: One draft and one correction pass; unclear or sensitive passages return to manual writing.
loop.why_not_simpler: Free-text accounts need careful condensation; templates cannot preserve their meaning alone.

Check termination paperwork and approve the departure instructions.
File approved documents and update the departure status.
Send approved payroll instructions and departure actions to responsible teams.

tasks.short: Check applicant references and relevant background evidence before hiring.

steps.what: Choose proportionate checks and confirm legal grounds, notices and required permissions.
Collect reference contacts and required background documents from the candidate.
Send authorised reference requests and chase missing responses.
Verify referee identity and discuss relevant evidence using a structured reference call.
Compare application claims with reference evidence and flag discrepancies.

loop.input: Application claims and authorised reference evidence, with verified source identities.
loop.output: A source-linked evidence table and possible discrepancies; no hiring recommendation.
loop.check: Validate dates deterministically; require source passages for claims and human verification of material discrepancies.
loop.stop: One extraction pass and one repair pass per evidence bundle; unresolved or unsupported items go to HR.
loop.why_not_simpler: Structured forms cover routine facts, but reference letters and call notes express dates and qualifications inconsistently.

steps.what: Resolve material discrepancies with the candidate and approve the check outcome.

tasks.design: Configure candidate forms, authorised requests, reminders and check status in the {ATS} and {WORKFLOW}. A bounded loop compares unstructured evidence from the {DOCS} with application claims and produces a source-linked table; HR verifies referees, hears explanations and approves the check outcome.

tasks.still_hard: Referee authenticity, evasive answers and disputed histories need personal investigation. Criminal and other restricted background data require specific legal conditions under GDPR and national rules; employee or applicant consent alone may be insufficient.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish an innocent mismatch from material misrepresentation and give the applicant a fair opportunity to explain.

Approve final policy wording, effective date and implementation responsibilities.
